hints: Focus on shape, not just formula. Three atoms in a straight line means a bond angle of 180 degrees at the middle atom.
Recall the key bond angles. Tetrahedral centres are about 109.5 degrees, while an octahedral molecule also has opposite bonds at 180 degrees.
Check each structure for a central atom with two bonds pointing in exactly opposite directions to give that linear F-X-F or C-X-C unit.
walkthrough:
**Understand what straight line means**

Think of three atoms A-B-C where B is in the middle. For them to be straight, the angle A-B-C must be 180 degrees.

Bond angle needed:
$$\text{A-B-C} = 180^{\circ}$$

**Check the organic chains**

In poly(ethene), $\text{-CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{-}$, and in propane, $\text{C}_3\text{H}_8$, every carbon is tetrahedral with 4 sigma bonds and no lone pairs.

Tetrahedral angle:
$$\text{bond angle} \approx 109.5^{\circ}$$
So C-C-C and H-C-H units are bent, never 180 degrees.

**Check silicon tetrachloride**

$\text{SiCl}_4$ has 4 bonding pairs and no lone pairs on Si, so it is tetrahedral too.

$$\text{Cl-Si-Cl} \approx 109.5^{\circ}$$
All Cl-Si-Cl angles are the same bent angle, so no three atoms are linear.

**Check sulfur hexafluoride**

$\text{SF}_6$ has 6 bonding pairs and no lone pairs, so it is octahedral. Adjacent F atoms are 90 degrees apart, but opposite F atoms are directly across from each other.

$$\text{F-S-F (trans)} = 180^{\circ}$$
That trans F-S-F unit is three atoms bonded in a straight line, so this is the match.

options.A: Incorrect. Poly(ethene) is made of tetrahedral $\text{CH}_2$ groups. All C-C-C, C-C-H and H-C-H angles are about 109.5 degrees, so the chain is zig-zag, not straight.
options.B: Incorrect. Propane $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_3$ has tetrahedral carbons. The C-C-C angle is about 109.5 degrees, so the three carbons form a bent shape, not a straight line.
options.C: Incorrect. $\text{SiCl}_4$ is tetrahedral with bond angle about 109.5 degrees. Students sometimes confuse tetrahedral symmetry with linearity, but no Cl-Si-Cl angle is 180 degrees.
options.D: Correct. $\text{SF}_6$ is octahedral. While cis F-S-F is 90 degrees, the trans F-S-F across the sulfur is 180 degrees, which is exactly three atoms (F-S-F) bonded together in a straight line.
